name: Da Lat Cathedral
summary: Stand on Tran Phu for the pink facade and the bell tower with a rooster on top, the reason locals call it the Chicken Church. It was completed in 1942. Twenty minutes outside is enough, and morning puts the light on the front.
getThere: Walk from Xuan Huong Lake to Tran Phu
heroCaption: The cathedral and its bell tower
body: Stand on Tran Phu for the pink facade and the rooster on the bell tower. The church was completed in 1942. Morning light falls on the front, and twenty minutes is enough outside.
The pink convent church with the garden is Domaine de Marie, a separate stop at 1 Ngo Quyen on the west ridge. Pair the two if churches are your interest.

figures.caption: The bell tower from below
figures.alt: Looking up at the bell tower of Da Lat Cathedral

gettingThere: The cathedral is on Tran Phu, a short walk from Xuan Huong Lake.
admissionNote: Free to view outside (Visit Lâm Đồng). Interior hours and any interior fee are Check on arrival.
